purpose: Guarantee that scoreable reflection/still evidence uses the already-developed physical facade rough openings, world-aligned aperture UVs, deterministic apartment occupancy variation and physical glass-edge thickness, rather than silently rendering the lower-fidelity facade-optics-only state.
formalPreparationOrder: sceneSaving-bound 4 mm glass perimeter edge construction
registered material + physical UV + facade formal-build validation

reflectionLifecyclePolicy.firstPreProbeFingerprint: May build a missing generated pass, then performs full source-side validation and freezes optics/aperture/occupancy instance IDs.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.subsequentEditorPolls: Must not write runtime reports or rebuild scene state. They revalidate physical UVs, occupancy, glass thickness and a report-free aperture construction fingerprint.
reflectionLifecyclePolicy.inFlightMutation: Missing or replaced aperture/occupancy root under the same optics instance is a hard failure; no automatic repair is permitted while reflection evidence may be in flight.

requiredEvidence: hero/facade_center at 3840x2160 plus 100% review for repeated occupancy modules, opaque fallback intrusion and window construction seating
oblique/construction_depth at 3840x2160 plus 100% crop for 0.22 m RC rough-opening depth, perimeter seals, glazing/curtain ordering and light leaks
grazing/sash_rail_response at 3840x2160 plus 100% crop for physical UV scale, sash/seal/glass interfaces and non-painted grazing response
grazing/material_grazing and temporal pixels at 100% for concrete repetition, curtain/track LOD changes, thin glass-edge shimmer and reflection continuity
limitations: This binding proves only that the higher-fidelity source passes are present and validated before formal reflection evidence; it does not prove their pixels are photorealistic.
Source-side geometry/metadata validation cannot clear obvious_repetition, major_light_leak, hero_geometry_intersection or any other visual critical defect without actual native render evidence.
Unity 6000.3.0f1 compilation, scene serialization order, reflection-probe execution and 3840x2160 rendered output remain runtime verification pending until a Runner is available.
Existing generated passes are validated rather than silently regenerated so evidence-state drift fails closed instead of being hidden during a formal packet.
